completion_rule: Every required component must be implemented through reachable solver code in the same direction before the method claim can pass semantic review.
variant_rule: Adapt every component to all active requirement and IO constraints. Variant-specific knowledge extends this contract instead of disabling its core search lifecycle.

required_components.title: Explicit search state and legal initialization
required_behaviors: Maintain operation assignment and explicit per-machine sequences using stable operation identities.
Construct at least one complete legal state from the active IO and preserve seeded reproducibility.
Keep current state and global-best state as separate clones or immutable snapshots.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable initialization and clone paths used by solve().

required_components.title: Complete progress decoder
required_behaviors: Decode job and machine precedence together until every operation is scheduled.
Reject cycles, deadlocks, partial coverage, ineligible assignments, and active-variant violations without mutating the incumbent.
Use selected processing durations and validate the complete output before serialization.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable decoder, deadlock guard, coverage checks, and final validation.

required_components.title: Exact critical graph and tight machine blocks
required_behaviors: Compute forward and backward timing on the current disjunctive graph.
Identify zero-slack critical operations.
Build maximal critical machine blocks only across tight machine arcs.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable timing propagation and tight-arc block extraction consumed by neighborhood generation.

required_components.title: N7/N8-style and K-insertion machine-order neighborhood
required_behaviors: Generate bounded critical-block endpoint moves and non-adjacent K-insertion candidates.
Modify explicit machine order rather than only rescheduling fixed assignments.
Retain only fully decoded legal candidates and keep deadline checks inside nested scans.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable candidate generator showing endpoint/position bounds and more than adjacent swaps.

required_components.title: Alternative-machine reassignment and bounded insertion
required_behaviors: Remove an operation from its old sequence and assign it only to an eligible target machine.
Derive a bounded target insertion window from job predecessor/successor timing and target-machine order.
Decode and validate each retained reassignment candidate under active variant constraints.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable reassignment generator and insertion-window calculation consumed by search.

required_components.title: Consistent candidate generation, scoring, and application
required_behaviors: Carry one stable move identity and exact target parameters from generation through scoring and application.
Apply each candidate to a clone or restorable snapshot and commit only after complete decode succeeds.
Ensure a failed, timed-out, or cyclic candidate leaves current and global-best states unchanged.
required_components.evidence_required: One reachable move object/state path proving that the scored move is exactly the applied move.

required_components.title: Reverse-move tabu and global-best aspiration
required_behaviors: Use the same attribute representation when testing a candidate and storing the inverse of an accepted move.
Cover both same-machine and machine-reassignment inverse moves without truncated or ambiguous sequence identity.
Allow a tabu move only when its fully decoded objective strictly improves the global best.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable tabu lookup/store paths and a behavioral inverse-move test.

required_components.title: Effective adaptive weight or zi scoring
required_behaviors: Update operation weights and cooldown/age state from accepted search transitions.
Consume those changing values in reachable candidate scoring or selection.
Avoid dead variables, constant terms, or updates that cannot affect a move decision.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable update and scoring paths plus a test showing ranking changes when adaptive state changes.

required_components.title: Bounded diversification with global-best preservation
required_behaviors: Trigger a bounded perturbation, restart, or controlled randomization after measured stagnation.
Diversification must change the reachable search trajectory while preserving the global best.
All random choices must derive from the declared seed.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable stagnation trigger, diversification transition, and best-state preservation.

required_components.title: Shared runtime budget and stage contribution evidence
required_behaviors: Use one absolute deadline across construction, nested candidate scans, validation, and serialization.
Bound candidate materialization and machine-link traversal by explicit caps or operation count.
Expose counters for evaluated, feasible, accepted, and improving moves so dead stages can be detected.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable deadline checks and stage counters produced by the solver or self-check.

coupled_groups.rule: Tightening critical blocks must not be accepted without the paired sequence and reassignment neighborhoods that preserve useful search coverage.
The move that is evaluated, selected, applied, and stored as inverse tabu must remain the same identifiable move.
Adaptive pressure and diversification count as implemented only when reachable decisions change and runtime evidence shows the stages execute.
